title: tmcp-fdtd: FDTD code and data for sideband generation and polarization conversion in a CP patch antenna on a time-modulated substrate
description: Three-dimensional FDTD solver (Python/numba) with a displacement-field update for time-varying permittivity, CPML, near-to-far-field transformation and an exact harmonic-resolved power balance, together with all simulation data and scripts that reproduce every table and figure of the article FDTD Analysis of Sideband Generation and Polarization Conversion in a Circularly Polarized Patch Antenna on a Time-Modulated Substrate (Microwave and Optical Technology Letters, submitted) and its Supporting Information. Run python reproduce.py all.
